title: Web3Hunt
tagline: Web3Hunt is THE hunting ground for all web3 products, starting with NFTs. It’s the one-stop-shop for you to conduct market and social intelligence research and discover your new NFTs, DeFi protocols, tokens, basically all things in web3!
description:
Web3Hunt is THE hunting ground for all web3 products, starting with NFTs. It’s the one-stop-shop for you to conduct market and social intelligence research and discover your new NFTs, DeFi protocols, tokens, basically all things in web3. This project uses React for the frontend and Ruby on Rails for the backend. We pulled a UI template from https://github.com/johnschoeman/product_hunt_app. Additionally, we are using below sponsors:
1. Covalent: API to pull NFT Market Data
2. NFTPort:
    1) to search for NFT collections to find their images (https://docs.nftport.xyz/docs/nftport/b3A6MjA0MjY5MjE-multi-chain-nft-search) and 
    2) to find out how unique a project's images are (https://docs.nftport.xyz/docs/nftport/b3A6MjQzMjIyNzk-find-counterfeit-nf-ts-w-url )
3. IPFS to store comments
